description: This file defines the `NationalityFixture` class used in PHPUnit tests for the OrangeHRM project. It extends an abstract fixture class and retrieves all `Nationality` entities from the database, formatting them into an array for test purposes.

classes.name: NationalityFixture
classes.description: A PHPUnit fixture class for retrieving and formatting nationality data from the database for testing.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves all Nationality entities, extracts their IDs and names, and returns this data in an array structured for testing.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename 'Nationality.yaml' associated with this fixture.
